CustomField.description: Fundraising Quick Start: audit + trigger flag for the default OutreachSourceCode auto-created on Tactical-level Campaigns (FQS_Hierarchy_Depth__c >= 3). Set to true by FQS_CampaignHierarchyBuilder after it provisions the default OSC. If flipped from false to true manually, the FQS_Campaign_Create_Default_OSCs record-triggered flow calls FQS_OutreachSourceCodeBuilder to (re)create the default OSC. Idempotent via External_Id__c = 'FQS-OSC-{CampaignId18}-DEFAULT'.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates the default Outreach Source Code has been auto-provisioned. Set automatically by hierarchy builder; can be checked manually to (re)create the default OSC on a Tactical-level campaign. Idempotent — safe to re-check.
CustomField.label: Create Default Outreach Sources
